description: Which minerals the dossier covers, the HS code curated for each, and the caveats on comparing supply to trade. FREE. Worth calling before minerals.dossier for two reasons: the cobalt and lithium HS headings exist nowhere else in this API, since trade.codes lists headings only for catalog instruments and neither mineral has one; and the HS code here is chosen to match the USGS production basis, so copper, nickel and zinc point at ore headings rather than the refined-metal headings their instruments use. Also reports which minerals currently have US net import reliance and which column it was read from.
